unique_slides._comment: Unique-slide pass (pipeline/dso_pipeline/unique_slides.py). Runs after key-frame extraction, never re-runs Whisper. Default mode is slides_only: keep slide and document pictures, drop face cams and stage cameras, crop to the shared screen. Two frames are the same slide when every small block of that area (ignoring a moving cursor) has <= 5 % of its pixels changed by > 24. A changed bullet or number is a new slide. These keys override the defaults in code.
